titles.title: Three Women

description: Vertical watercolor - Three female figures, two facing forward, main one in center foreground turned away.  All hooded in dark shawls, two with stylized skirts of ochre, and patterned pink squares.  Graphite sketching visible in white areas of paper between colors.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
